intent: The user asks for a reminder to drink water every minute. The bot should learn a persistent routine, remind on its own with no input while the clock runs, stop when asked, and stay quiet afterwards.

steps.say: Please remind me to drink water every minute.
Thanks, you can stop the water reminders now.

criteria.learning: The request becomes a persistent routine on the turn it is asked.
criteria.schedule: Water reminders arrive about once a minute with no input.
criteria.stopping: Asked to stop, the bot stops the routine and no more reminders come.
